brief.notes: Jithesh 31 Oct 11:42 on extended v2: 'lyrics and the tune don't match'. Root cause: we wrote lyrics first and forced them on v4's melody. Now the reverse: v4 take 2's own transcript (semma-paiyan-source/upload.json) gives each sung phrase's time and syllables; new real Tamil words with the same syllable count and stress per phrase (konnakol fragments become real words: 'Sollu sollu, yaaru yaaru', 'Aadu aadu, paadu paadu, aattam podu'; swaras stay swaras), each phrase group regenerated on its exact v4 slice at condition_strength xhigh; intro 0-15 s and ending kept exactly. 60 s test before extending.

story: A Chennai guy gets dumped by text on a Monday and brags he is the best guy she will ever find, dancing the hurt away with his friends. Twist: he accidentally likes her new photo.
